description: Lebanese direct-to-consumer handbag brand selling women's bags through its own website and app, running a direct ambassador program that pays creators a percentage of every delivered order their personal code brings in.

evidence.summary: Mist's own ambassador page states the program terms: 10% commission on every delivered order placed with the ambassador's personal code, a 10% follower discount, free first bags, 50% off showcase bags, a 6-month term, and monthly payouts by the 10th via Whish Money, OMT or bank transfer.

The brand's own program page states 'No cap on earnings' in its headline terms and repeats 'No cap' in the commission section ('Your commission — On every delivered order your code brings in. No cap.'), so commission_cap is recorded as uncapped.

The page is built for content creators: ambassadors post Mist bags on their own terms with no minimum posting, sales are tracked live in the Mist app, and Mist may reshare ambassador content with credit during the term.

Program terms state Lebanese law applies and Beirut courts decide disputes, and payouts are made in US dollars — a small, Lebanon-based brand running the program directly rather than through a network.

name: Mist Lebanon

reasons.compensation: Published 10% commission on the brand's own page with an explicit no-cap statement, plus free product and 50% off showcase bags — strong, fully published terms for a small brand.

reasons.credibility: Small Lebanon-based DTC bag brand with its own store and app; limited third-party footprint, so credibility is scored conservatively.

reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications are publicly open on the brand's site and reviewed individually; no follower minimum is stated.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A formal ambassador program with free product, live in-app sales tracking and brand resharing of ambassador content — clear, structured creator collaboration.

description: Partner program of iFly, an Australian online travel agency (subsidiary of Magic Tours International) accredited with ATAS/AFTA and IATA, paying partners a percentage of every flight ticket sold through their affiliate site, with reporting run through OSI Affiliate.

The FAQ states partners earn a percentage of the value of every ticket sold via their affiliate site, with a worked example: at an average flight of $2000 AUD the commission would be $20 (implying roughly 1%, though no headline rate is published — so commission_rate is null). Approved partners get a dashboard login, and the program is managed with OSI Affiliate.

The FAQ states iFly is a licensed Australian online travel agent operating online for more than 10 years, a subsidiary of Magic Tours International Pty Ltd (operating 30+ years), accredited with the Australian Federation of Travel Agents (AFTA/ATAS) and IATA, and headquartered on the Gold Coast.
The program is pitched at referrers who recommend iFly to friends, family and contacts; iFly handles all ticketing, changes and customer support for referred clients.
